question:
**In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

We all get goose bumps which are a reflex reaction by a human (1)_____. to a sudden drop in temperatures or feelings of panic, anger or extreme fear. They are also (2)_______ by itty-bitty muscles in our hair follicles.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'body; created'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct options to fill in the blanks are **'body; created'.**
 
• The sentence talks about goosebumps, which are a reflex reaction by the human body.
 
• So, the most appropriate word to fill the first blank is **"body."**
 
• Additionally, the sentence refers to goosebumps being generated by tiny muscles in our hair follicles, hence the word** "generated" **fits appropriately in the second blank to indicate the production or creation of goosebumps.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *We all get goose bumps which are a reflex reaction by a human **body**. to a sudden drop in temperatures or feelings of panic, anger or extreme fear. They are also **created** by itty-bitty muscles in our hair follicles.*
